sonnet.problem: Verse 1 says only 'Some time after these events.' The card ties that to Israel's win over Aram and cites 1 Kings 20:29, which the text does not say. The events right before this passage are not that battle.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The card tells Ahab's reaction when Elijah confronts him over Naboth's murder, a serious sin. It makes a joke comparing that to getting caught with a hand in the cookie jar, which makes light of the murder.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts").
